# Hip Baby Gear

> New England's premier baby gear retailer specializing in premium strollers, car seats, and nursery furniture with expert CPST-certified guidance.

Hip Baby Gear is a curated baby equipment retailer serving New England customers with locations in Marblehead. They offer expert consultation on safety-certified products from leading brands including UPPAbaby, Nuna, Bugaboo, Cybex, Clek, and Maxi-Cosi, along with current promotions and seasonal sales.

## Car Seats & Safety

- [Car Seats | Safest Infant, Convertible & Booster Seats](https://www.hipbabygear.com/gear/car-seats): Car seat shopping with CPST-certified experts for Clek, Nuna, Cybex, Babyark.
- [Infant Car Seats | Safe Starts for Newborns](https://www.hipbabygear.com/gear/car-seats/infant-car-seats): Infant car seats from Nuna, Clek, Cybex, and Babyark for newborn safety.
- [Convertible Car Seats | Grow-With-Me Safety](https://www.hipbabygear.com/gear/car-seats/convertible-car-seats): Convertible car seats that adapt from rear-facing to forward-facing positions.
- [Combination Car Seats | Harness to Booster in One](https://www.hipbabygear.com/gear/car-seats/combination-car-seats): Combination car seats transitioning from harness to booster in one design.
- [Booster Seats | Safe Solutions for Growing Kids](https://www.hipbabygear.com/gear/car-seats/booster-seats): Booster seats from Maxi-Cosi and Clek for growing children.
- [Car Seat Bases | Extra Convenience & Secure Installs](https://www.hipbabygear.com/gear/car-seats/bases): Car seat bases from babyark and UPPAbaby for flexible, secure installations.
- [Baby Proofing](https://www.hipbabygear.com/gear/baby-proofing): Baby proofing products including safety gates, outlet plugs, and furniture straps.
